resource.name: Community posts
resource.description: Public community posts for the Community tab. Posts are standalone user-authored content and must not affect recommendation ranking or fuel-cost calculations.

endpoints.name: List community posts
endpoints.description: Return public community posts. Anonymous users can read and search the list.

query.description: Case-insensitive search over title, content, and tags.

tag.description: Filter posts whose tag list contains a tag exactly equal to the query tag, case-insensitively.

limit.description: Server-bounded list size. Invalid or values below 1 fall back to 50; values above 100 are capped at 100.

endpoints.name: Create community post
endpoints.description: Create a community post with title, content, and optional tags. No location linkage or visit proof is accepted or required.

endpoints.name: Read community post
endpoints.description: Return a single public community post.

endpoints.name: Update community post
endpoints.description: Partially update a post. The backend fetches the post by id first; an authenticated non-author receives COMMUNITY_POST_FORBIDDEN with HTTP 403, not an owner-filtered 404.

endpoints.name: Delete community post
endpoints.description: Delete a post. The backend fetches the post by id first; an authenticated non-author receives COMMUNITY_POST_FORBIDDEN with HTTP 403, not an owner-filtered 404.

can_edit.description: True only for the authenticated author.

CommunityPostWritePartial.description: Any subset of title, content, and tags; at least one field must be provided.

implementationNotes: CommunityPost belongs to the Django user model only.
GET list/detail are public; create/update/delete are auth-gated.
Update/delete must return COMMUNITY_POST_FORBIDDEN with HTTP 403 for authenticated non-authors.
The Community tab is public in the frontend navigation; write controls show login guidance for anonymous users.
No visit proof field, location-link workflow, or proof upload is part of this contract.
Community posts must not be read by recommendation endpoints and must not influence recommendation ranking, distance, discount, or cost.
